reportMarkdown:
## Post-Content-Size Taffy Profile Finished

**Index:** 54
**Checkpoint:** `26deae02c78fdb1e53cca3a1d8168af183455665`
**Attempt Count:** 1

### Report

**Passed Status:** true. Headed WebGPU CPU profiles at DPR 1 and DPR 2 preserved exact final offsets, all established renderer/layout/identity counters, and zero terminal errors. The multithreaded build again reported 98,441 atomic-prefix bytes.

Using the same classifier as experiment 52, Taffy compute self time fell 8.30%/8.26% at DPR 1/2. Flexbox self time fell 2.33%/6.15%, block-layout self time fell 20.70%/13.24%, and all Taffy self time fell 8.19%/8.09%. Inclusive compute moved -0.31%/-3.95%, while flexbox remains the dominant layout family at 807.844/777.501 ms.

### Scope Lock

Measurement only. No source, dependency, fixture, renderer, shader, layout, memory, or public API change was made.

### Decision

Retain the no-content-size configuration: direct profiles confirm the removed bookkeeping mechanism. Investigate measured-leaf invalidation next, because 229 measured nodes are marked dirty every frame and may be forcing otherwise stable flex/block ancestors to recompute.
decisionMarkdown: Retain experiment 53. Direct profiles show Taffy compute self time down 8.30%/8.26% and all Taffy self time down 8.19%/8.09% at DPR 1/2. Flexbox remains dominant; measure repeated measured-leaf inputs and outputs before changing invalidation semantics.
